Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: US stock futures kick off September under pressure as yields, oil prices rise
Markets.summary: US stock futures declined at the start of September as Treasury yields and oil prices increased. The market drop follows rising economic pressures heading into the new month.

Markets.title: India bonds inch lower, joining global debt selloff
Markets.summary: Indian bond prices declined as part of a wider global debt selloff driven by rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions. These factors stoked inflation fears and foreign investor outflows, increasing speculation that the Reserve Bank of India might raise interest rates.

Markets.title: Why Japan's 30-year high bond yields should worry Indian stock market investors
Markets.summary: Japan's 30-year high bond yields, combined with hawkish US Federal Reserve policies and rising oil prices, are straining global liquidity. These global pressures are negatively impacting Indian equities despite India's strong 7.8% GDP growth.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by Benjamin Graham: "The stockholder wants both income and appreciation, but in general the more he gets of one the less he realizes of the other"
Markets.summary: Benjamin Graham noted a fundamental trade-off where stocks offering higher dividend income typically provide less capital appreciation, and vice versa. Investors must balance immediate cash flows with growth by aligning their stock choices with their financial goals and risk tolerance.

Markets.title: RBI intervention, dollar flows push Indian rupee to two-month peak
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee reached a two-month high against the U.S. dollar, driven by Reserve Bank of India interventions and foreign bank inflows. Positive domestic growth boosted the currency, despite pressures from rising global bond yields and higher crude oil prices.

Markets.title: Global Market: European shares muted as bond yields surge on inflation concerns
Markets.summary: European shares remained nearly unchanged on Tuesday as rising government bond yields and inflation concerns made investors cautious. Meanwhile, energy stocks rose 1.4% as Brent crude traded near $92 per barrel.

Geo-Political.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
Geo-Political.summary: So far this year, Pakistan and Iran have forced one million people to return to Afghanistan, bringing the total number of deportees to six million. Many of these individuals were born abroad and have never actually lived in Afghanistan.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal death toll crosses 1,000 as rescuers race to find workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels
Geo-Political.summary: The death toll in Nepal has exceeded 1,000 as rescue workers search for people trapped in mud-filled tunnels, while thousands remain missing. Meanwhile, Chinese state media have reported 16 fatalities in Tibet due to the same disaster.

Geo-Political.title: Russian attack hits rail workers in new deadly strikes on Kyiv
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian attack on Kyiv and its surrounding region struck rail workers and injured 20 people. The victims included two children.

Geo-Political.title: The final minutes before floodwater crashed through Nepal-China border
Geo-Political.summary: Over 100 Indians are missing following devastating Himalayan floods at a Nepal-China trade crossing. The disaster struck the vital border area, resulting in the current search for the missing individuals.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli fire kills three in Gaza City during reported raid, medics say
Geo-Political.summary: Palestinian medics reported that Israeli fire killed three people in Gaza City during a military operation. Local reports stated that the incident followed air and artillery strikes triggered by the discovery of an Israel-backed militia raid.

Geo-Political.title: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
Geo-Political.summary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis was convicted for orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting of rapper Tupac Shakur. The former gang boss was found guilty nearly 30 years after the rap superstar's murder.

Data & Insights.summary: Russia has lowered its projected 2026 oil output to a 17-year low. Meanwhile, rising crude exports and strong purchases by India continue to drive Moscow's key Asian oil market.

Data & Insights.title: Centre slashes sugar dealers’ stock limit to 2,000 quintals from 15 September
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced the stock limit for sugar dealers to 2,000 quintals starting September 15. This measure aims to maintain adequate domestic sugar supplies at stable prices ahead of the festive season.

Data & Insights.title: Q1 GDP growth beats expectations: Are foreign investors underestimating India's resilience?
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q1 GDP grew by a better-than-expected 7.8%, driven by strong investment and fiscal improvements. Despite geopolitical tensions and oil price concerns, these strong fundamentals highlight the economy's resilience against foreign skepticism.

Data & Insights.title: GST collections rise 14.8% to  ₹1.99 trillion in August; refunds jump 68%
Data & Insights.summary: India's Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections rose 14.8% year-on-year to ₹1.99 trillion in August. This followed July collections of ₹2.11 trillion, while tax refunds jumped by 68% during the month.

Data & Insights.title: PMI manufacturing slips to near five-year low in August
Data & Insights.summary: India's manufacturing growth slowed to a near five-year low in August due to cooling demand and output cuts. This resulted in a slight decline in factory jobs despite easing cost pressures.

Data & Insights.title: From Brics summit to Tim Cook’s legacy and AI’s job exposure, top global news in 5 charts
Data & Insights.summary: Major global news trends include India hosting the growing Brics summit, diverging inflation rates, and Tim Cook's departure from Apple. Additional key developments feature rising youth unemployment in South Asia and the uneven impact of AI on jobs.

India.title: Chirag Paswan Gets Death Threat, Letter Mentions "Hardcore Terrorists"
India.summary: Union Minister Chirag Paswan received a death threat via a letter claiming involvement with hardcore terrorists. Security authorities have launched an investigation into the threat.

India.title: Parliamentary Panel Flags Delays In Scholarship Disbursal To Marginalised Students
India.summary: A parliamentary panel criticized authorities for delays in disbursing scholarships to marginalized students. The committee also condemned the decision to lower the 2026-27 beneficiary target to 34 lakh after missing previous goals.

India.title: GAIL Recruitment 2027: Notification Out For Executive Trainee Posts Via GATE
India.summary: GAIL has released a recruitment notification for Executive Trainee positions for the year 2027. Selection for these posts will be based strictly on candidates' GATE 2027 scores.

India.title: Scheduled Caste Livelihood Scheme: Parliamentry Panel Flags Only 17% Funds Utilised
India.summary: A parliamentary panel reported that only 17% of the Rs 920 crore budget for the PM-AJAY Grants-in-Aid scheme was utilized in 2025-26. This low spending has raised serious concerns among officials regarding the effective implementation of the Scheduled Caste livelihood program.

India.title: Opinion: Reporter's Diary | Roads Were Gone, We Kept Going: 6 Days Through Flood, Debris And Death In Nepal
India.summary: NDTV reporter Sikta Deo spent six harrowing days covering the disaster in flood-hit Nepal. She recounted navigating destroyed roads, debris, and death while reporting from the region.

India.title: 10 Teams, 30 Days: BJP Plans Nationwide Outreach Yatra On PM Modi's Birthday
India.summary: The BJP is planning a nationwide outreach yatra starting on Prime Minister Modi's birthday. The 30-day campaign will feature 10 teams of bikers and party workers traveling through towns, villages, and districts.

General.summary: Former Prime Minister Keir Starmer has announced that he is stepping down from his position as a Member of Parliament. He stated that he plans to dedicate his future efforts to international affairs.
